details: This project is a free local AI chatbot that runs on my own computer.

value: Build a Gemini-like local AI assistant
details: The assistant should chat use my own data remember useful information search the internet when needed and eventually use tools.
The project is developed in Visual Studio Code.
Python is the main programming language for the backend and AI integration.
Ollama is used to run the AI model locally on the computer.
The initial local model is a Qwen model running through Ollama.
FastAPI will be used to create the local web/API backend.
SQLite will be used for persistent local memory and application data.
RAG will let the assistant answer questions using the user's documents without retraining the model every time.
ChromaDB can be used later to store searchable document embeddings for RAG.
The assistant should eventually learn useful information from local documents.
The assistant should be able to retrieve current information from the internet when needed.
The assistant should store selected useful facts from conversations in a local database.
The final application should have a chat interface similar in concept to modern AI assistants.
Voice features may be added after the core chatbot RAG and memory systems work.
Image understanding may be added later so the assistant can analyze screenshots and images.
The finished application may be accessible from other devices on the same trusted local network.
